explication: AIOX is a CLI-first AI orchestration framework for software work: users install it into a project, activate specialist agents, and use them for planning and contextualized development. The README describes planning (PRD and architecture), story preparation, and the sm/dev/qa cycle, as well as IDE-specific agent entry points. The tree also exposes installation, updating, integrity validation, and MCP management as major product capabilities. Some framework runtime paths are absent from the supplied tree, so the graph shows documented capabilities without inventing their internal wiring; sampled sources support only the specific installer and MCP relationships shown.
